product: OpenSSL c_rehash (tools/c_rehash Perl script, shipped with the real OpenSSL build)
incomplete_fix_quote: In addition to the c_rehash shell command injection identified in CVE-2022-1292, further circumstances where the c_rehash script does not properly sanitise shell metacharacters to prevent command injection were found by code review.
cve_2022_1292_fix_commit: e5fd1728ef4c7a5bf7c7a7163ca60370460a6e23  (c_rehash: Do not use shell to invoke openssl; converts link_hash_cert/link_hash_crl backtick hash-compute to list-form compute_hash)
cve_2022_2068_fix_commit: 9639817dac8bbbaa64d09efad7464ccc405527c7  (Fix file operations in c_rehash; converts check_file 2-arg `open IN,$fname` to 3-arg `open(my $in,"<",$fname)` and cp/copy to pure-Perl)
call_site_original_v0_1_1_1n: link_hash_cert: my ($hash, $fprint) = `"$openssl" x509 $x509hash -fingerprint -noout -in "$fname"`;  (also link_hash_crl with single-quoted `'$fname'`)
call_site_original_fixed_v1_1_1_1o: link_hash_cert: my ($hash, $fprint) = compute_hash($openssl, "x509", $x509hash, "-fingerprint", "-noout", "-in", $fname);  -> compute_hash uses open($fh,"-|",@_) list form (no shell on non-VMS)
call_site_residual_MISSED_by_v1_1_1_1o: check_file: open IN, $fname;   (2-argument open -> a trailing-pipe filename runs a shell command; UNCHANGED from 1.1.1n through 1.1.1o)
call_site_residual_fixed_v2_1_1_1p: check_file: open(my $in, "<", $fname);   (3-argument open with explicit read mode -> literal path, no shell)
distinct_sites_note: The 1.1.1o fix escaped/list-formed the HASH-COMPUTATION exec path (link_hash_cert/link_hash_crl) but left the FILE-TYPE PROBE exec path (check_file's 2-arg open) untouched; 1.1.1p closed that second, distinct call site.
build_note: Verified against the REAL c_rehash generated by compiling OpenSSL 1.1.1n/o/p from upstream source (not a lifted script), invoking the real openssl binary for hashing.
